escalations.reason: Code review found a distinct notification-to-deadline timing gap after the configured two rework rounds were exhausted.
escalations.finding: The drain observer can report forced closure before axum-server starts its own drain deadline, so the count and log can be false.
escalations.decision_needed: Authorize one exceptional third rework round, accept the known logging defect, or defer/remove the issue from the v1.0 epic.
